name: Ojamajo Doremi Dokka~n!
summary: Based on the anime series Ojamajo Doremi, Ojamajo Doremi Dokkan! Nijiiro Paradise is a party game for up to four players in the Mario Party vein. Each player controls one of six characters from the anime. On each board, players move by rolling dice. Depending on where the character lands, they can learn spells, play one of 15 mini-games, gain or lose Rainbow Drops, exchange Rainbow Drops for items, or warp to another location. Players can also unlock extras while playing, such as special images, music and sound effects, and videos of the original series' title sequences.
